overview.description: The Direxion Daily SpaceX Bear 2X ETF (LOFD) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in communication services equity. The fund provides 2x inverse daily exposure, less fees and expenses, to the daily price movement for shares of Space Exploration Technologies Corp. (NYSE: SPCX), also known as SpaceX, through derivatives such as swaps. LOFD was launched on Aug 6, 2026 and is issued by Direxion.
